description: This is an abstract Java class defining a generic sales manager entity with common persistence-related methods, including ID handling, equality, hashing, and string representation, intended to serve as a base class for entities in a sales management system.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntity
classes.description: Abstract generic class representing a persistent entity with an identifiable key, providing common functionalities such as equality, hash code, comparison, and string conversion, designed for entities managed by Hibernate ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Determines if the entity has not been persisted yet by checking if the ID is null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare entities based on their ID, considering Hibernate proxies.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the entity's ID, ensuring consistency with equals.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Implements Comparable to compare entities based on their ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including the class name and ID.
